newsitem.title: USA: Just For Feet Q1 sales rose.
newsitem.headline: Just For Feet Q1 sales rose.

text.p: Just For Feet Inc said on Monday first quarter sales rose to a record $92.7 million.
First quarter revenues at the company's Just For Feet superstores rose 83.2 percent to $90,037,000 as compared to last year's quarterly sales of $49,150,000, the company said.
In addition, the company said, the 30 smaller specialty stores the company acquired from Athletic Attic on March 17, 1997 generated sales of $2,680,000.
Comparable store sales for Just For Feet superstores increased 5.0 percent for the first quarter of 1997 compared to the same quarter in 1996, the company said.
